thread:
Ben: Hey team, Ben here — excited to join. Quick: who should I ping for three things: Dedicated GPU access, routing policy changes (latency vs cost), and alert threshold tweaks?

eng-platform-bot: Welcome Ben! Owners are in the handbook owners page. Short answers below.

Maya: Hi Ben 44b. Routing policy config = eng-platform (I own review), model fallback rules = eng-runtime. For routing experiments use the sandbox policy key and tag your PR with routing-experiment.

Ben: Thanks. Dedicated GPU access?

Theo: Infra-access handles that. Run:
```n/request-dedicated-access --pool=dev-gpu-1 --reason="day1 testing" --owner=@Ben
```nThen open an infra ticket if you need quota > default. Normal turnaround 24h. DM me for fast-track.

Ben: And alerts?

Maya: Small threshold tweaks = PR in infra-alerts with eng-sre + eng-runtime reviewers. Big changes = schedule a quick 15-min sync with SRE. Always include rationale and metrics.

Ben: Perfect. One more: who to page for runtime slowness?

infra-bot: Page order: @eng-runtime-oncall, then @eng-sre if infra implicated. For customer-impacting issues also page @product-oncall. See playbook: https://playbooks.redwood.com/runtime-p99

Ben: Awesome — thanks all, I'll start the request and ping Theo if I need a fast approve.

Maya: Welcome aboard!
